Dear Ms. Ditto:

Thank you for your letter of November 4 addressed to Geoffrey Bible. We sincerely appreciate your interest in Philip Morris USA's Youth Smoking Prevention Department.

Philip Morris USA's Youth Smoking Prevention Department is committed to reducing the incidence of youth smoking. We are developing ways to address this issue for children aged 10-14 and unfortunately these books are for kids who fall outside the age group we are focusing on. I am therefore returning your materials to you.

Thank you for taking the time to get in touch with us and for thinking of Philip Morris USA.

Sincerely,

[SIGNATURE] ORFELLEES

Henry Fernandez
